Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 106. Category: feat. Altered dnd 5e feats.

You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks
with certain kinds of spells, gaining the following
benefits:
When you cast a spell that requires you to make an
attack roll, the spell’s range is doubled.
Your ranged spell attacks ignore half cover and
three-quarters cover.
You learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll.
Your spellcasting modifier for this cantrip is either
Charisma or Intellegence which you choose when
you gain this Feat
